verdict.rationale: A government agency running transactional e-Services for employers could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path on edd.ca.gov returned 404. The documentation describes only web-portal services and payment channels (FSET, EFT/ACH), with no downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
